> 第439章 火骷髅（第1页）
“这总烧死了吧。”林冰雪松了口气。
“这若还烧不死那真的是神仙了。”黄天少无语道。
“柳先生，这次多亏有你，不然我们这些人根本搞不死这家伙。”黄天少难的夸赞柳大春。
“嗯，也离不开你们。这事我也没有想到会变成这样。”柳大春回答道。
这时，其他民警的脸色渐渐的难看起来。
柳大春看到，大火烧尽过后，本以为都是灰烬，这倒上汽油的，一般来说，骨头都会烧干净。
然而，大火熄灭，一个人形骨架还站立在那里。
浑身上下都已经烧得只剩下骨架了，头也已经烧成骷髅头了。
但是，细看的话，他的头骨没有烧裂开，头骨里面的脑髓似乎还保留着。
“我的天呐，他还活着！！？”林冰雪和所有人都震惊了。
这到底是什么类型的怪物这样都不死的？
是修魔的生命力强到可怕，还是永生是真存在的？？
可给他们震惊的时间并不多，这地藏小鬼王的骷髅骨架已经大开杀戒了。
现在，是真的刀不怕，枪不怕，火也不怕。
地藏小鬼王一下子窜过去，他的头骨手臂直接穿透了最近的一名还在发愣的民警。
骷髅手穿透了他的心脏，将他的心脏直接给掏了出来，那骷髅手里的心脏赫然还在跳动。
没了心脏的民警愣了一下，低头看了一眼，脸色发青，连给他恐惧的时间都没有，已经一命呜呼了。
黄天少，林冰雪等众多民警马上拔枪继续射击。

可是一个骷髅骨架，射他有什么用呢？？
柳大春马上跟上，冲击，一拳打在了对方的骨架上，但没想到，对方的骨架赫然没有散架。
“我应该感谢你，用火烧我，我修魔，主属性就是火，你我炼就了真身，哈哈哈。”地藏小鬼王狂笑着。
这是柳大春也没想到的，他的飞刀突然启动，直钻对方的眼睛窟窿。
但地藏小鬼王直接用骷髅手挡了下来。
“柳大春，我还会回来的，后会有期。”
地藏小鬼王说着，快速爬上墙壁，从屋顶上方逃蹿。
柳大春追了些距离，但黑夜没有视线，加上房屋建筑的阻碍，很快就跟丢了。
“现在怎么办？”林冰雪也很着急。
“我也没有好的办法。”柳大春实话实说，虽然他是可以封印对方的，但如今条件也不满足啊。
“这怪胎身手太敏捷了，真没想到速度这么快。”
一是生命力强；二就是敏捷性极高，像个黑夜里的刺客。
“那也只能走一步看一步了。”林冰雪也很无奈。
“不过经过这事，加上我在，他刚才说他还会回来的，说明他八成离开这个镇了。”柳大春推测道。
民警都怕了，这波抓捕又死了好多人，有混混，还有民警牺牲。
但这个祸害也成了柳大春心里的刺了。

> Chapter 439 Fire Skeleton (Page 1)
"This will definitely burn you to death." Lin Bingxue breathed a sigh of relief.
"If he can't be burned to death, he's really a god." Huang Tianshao said speechlessly.
"Mr. Liu, thanks to you this time, otherwise we wouldn't be able to kill this guy." Huang Tianshao praised Liu Dachun.
"Well, I can't do without you either. I didn't expect it to turn out like this." Liu Dachun replied.
At this time, the faces of other police officers gradually turned ugly.
Liu Dachun saw that after the fire burned out, he thought it was all ashes, but if gasoline was poured on it, the bones would generally be burned clean.
However, the fire was extinguished and a humanoid skeleton remained standing there.
His whole body had been burned to the point where only a skeleton was left, and his head had been burned into a skull.
However, if you look closely, his skull has not been burned and cracked, and the brain inside the skull seems to be still preserved.
"Oh my God, he is still alive!!?" Lin Bingxue and everyone were shocked.
What kind of monster is this that doesn't die like this?
Is the vitality of cultivating demons so terrifying, or does eternal life really exist? ?
But they didn't have much time to be shocked. The skeleton of the Ksitigarbha Ghost King had already started killing.
Now, it is true that we are not afraid of knives, guns, or fire.
Ksitigarbha Imp King rushed over, and his skull arm directly penetrated the nearest policeman who was still in a daze.
The skeleton's hand penetrated his heart and took out his heart directly. The heart in the skeleton's hand was still beating.
The heartless policeman was stunned for a moment, looked down, and his face turned blue. He didn't even have time to be afraid, and he was already dead.
Huang Tianshao, Lin Bingxue and many other police officers immediately drew their guns and continued shooting.
But what's the use of shooting a skeleton? ?
Liu Dachun immediately followed up, struck, and punched the opponent's frame. Unexpectedly, the opponent's frame did not fall apart.
"I should thank you for burning me with fire. I am cultivating demons. The main attribute is fire. You and I have cultivated our true bodies, hahaha." Ksitigarbha Little Ghost King laughed wildly.
This was something Liu Dachun didn't expect. His flying knife suddenly started to go straight into the opponent's eyes.
But Ksitigarbha Imp King directly blocked it with his skeleton hand.
"Liu Dachun, I will come back. See you later."
Ksitigarbha Imp King said, quickly climbed up the wall and escaped from the roof.
Liu Dachun chased for some distance, but with no sight in the dark night and the obstruction of buildings, he quickly lost track of him.
"What to do now?" Lin Bingxue was also anxious.
"I don't have a good way." Liu Dachun told the truth. Although he could seal the other party, the conditions were not met now.
"This freak is so agile. I didn't expect it to be so fast."
One is that he has strong vitality; the other is that he is extremely agile, like an assassin in the dark.
"Then we can only take one step at a time." Lin Bingxue was also helpless.
"But after this incident, plus my presence, and the fact that he just said he would come back, it means that he has probably left this town." Liu Dachun speculated.
The police were all scared. Many people died in this wave of arrests, including gangsters and police officers.
But this scourge also became a thorn in Liu Dachun's heart.
